input: Explain prompt caching in one paragraph.
output: Prompt caching stores a processed prefix so repeat calls skip re-encoding it: you mark a stable prefix once, pay full price on the first call, then a fraction on cache hits within the TTL. Copy-paste shape (Anthropic SDK): put fixed context first and mark the breakpoint — messages=[{"role":"system","content":[{"type":"text","text":SYSTEM,"cache_control":{"type":"ephemeral"}}]}] — then keep the variable user turn last so the cached prefix stays byte-identical across calls. Verify it worked by reading usage.cache_read_input_tokens on the second call: it should be > 0.
